create_actor: create an Actor instance with a serve_id, inference_mode, and robotics_api_connection to initialize the robot environment and policy
start_runloop: start the Actor runloop in a separate thread to begin the policy-environment interaction loop
set_instruction: set a new task instruction string on the Actor to guide the robot policy behavior
reset_from: reset the Actor with a new serve_id, inference_mode, and robotics_api_connection to reinitialize policy and runloop
shutdown_actor: shutdown the Actor by stopping the runloop and closing the robot environment
